title: Ramp Adds AI Business Spend Data to St Louis Fed FRED
summary:
The Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis is now distributing metrics on corporate capital allocation toward artificial intelligence to the general public. The dataset, known as "AI Business Spend," was provided by fintech firm Ramp and integrated into the FRED platform, allowing researchers and economists to monitor the scale and pace of AI adoption across the business sector.

The Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) project has provided curated and free access to American economic infrastructure data since 1991. Ramp employee Ara Kharazian, who has used the service since high school, noted that the submission of the firm's proprietary spending insights fulfills a long-term goal of contributing to the agency's public archives.
